data.one_liner: Get date and time format patterns from device system settings.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that retrieves date and time format patterns from the user's device system settings. It helps provide consistent, localized date and time formats that respect user preferences, and includes a widget scope to automatically sync patterns if the user changes settings while the app is running.
use_when: You need your app's date and time formatting to match the user's device system preferences
You want to react dynamically when a user changes their date and time system settings while the app is running
avoid_when: You prefer to enforce a single hardcoded date and time format across all users and regions
You are running on platforms or configurations where system pattern retrieval is unsupported or unnecessary
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
Includes SDTFScope for automatic syncing of patterns when device settings change
Provides WASM compatibility and Swift Package Manager support
weaknesses: Certain pattern getters like medium and full date patterns are not supported on Windows and Linux
Requires adding a manual script tag to index.html for web support
data.setup_notes: For web applications, you must include the system_date_time_format.js script in your index.html file.
